name: Language
subject: Language
description: Here you will find the expectations and learning for the four areas of study for Grade 1 Language.

strands.title: Literacy Connections and Applications
strands.describer: Throughout Grade 1, in connection with the learning in strands B to D, students will:

overall_expectations.title: Transferable Skills
overall_expectations.describer: Throughout Grade 1, in connection with the learning in strands B to D, students will:
overall_expectations.text: demonstrate an understanding of how the seven transferable skills (critical thinking and problem solving; innovation, creativity, and entrepreneurship; self-directed learning; collaboration; communication; global citizenship and sustainability; and digital literacy) are used in various language and literacy contexts
overall_expectations.text_html: demonstrate an understanding of how the seven transferable skills (critical thinking and problem solving; innovation, creativity, and entrepreneurship; self-directed learning; collaboration; communication; global citizenship and sustainability; and digital literacy) are used in various language and literacy contexts

specific_expectations.text: identify how transferable skills can be used to support communication in various cultural, social, linguistic, and domain-specific contexts, and apply them when reading, listening to, viewing, and creating texts of various forms
specific_expectations.text_html: identify how transferable skills can be used to support communication in various cultural, social, linguistic, and domain-specific contexts, and apply them when reading, listening to, viewing, and creating texts of various forms

specific_expectations.text: demonstrate an understanding of how transferable skills help them to express their voice and be engaged in their learning
specific_expectations.text_html: demonstrate an understanding of how transferable skills help them to express their voice and be engaged in their learning

overall_expectations.title: Digital Media Literacy
overall_expectations.describer: Throughout Grade 1, in connection with the learning in strands B to D, students will:
overall_expectations.text: demonstrate and apply the knowledge and skills needed to interact safely and responsibly in online environments, use digital and media tools to construct knowledge, and demonstrate learning as critical consumers and creators of media
overall_expectations.text_html: demonstrate and apply the knowledge and skills needed to interact safely and responsibly in online environments, use digital and media tools to construct knowledge, and demonstrate learning as critical consumers and creators of media

specific_expectations.text: demonstrate an understanding of their rights and responsibilities when interacting online with appropriate permission, and make decisions that contribute positively to the development of their digital identity and those of their communities
specific_expectations.text_html: demonstrate an understanding of their rights and responsibilities when interacting online with appropriate permission, and make decisions that contribute positively to the development of their digital identity and those of their communities

specific_expectations.text: demonstrate an understanding of how to navigate online environments safely, manage their privacy, and interact in a way that supports their well-being and that of others, including seeking appropriate permission
specific_expectations.text_html: demonstrate an understanding of how to navigate online environments safely, manage their privacy, and interact in a way that supports their well-being and that of others, including seeking appropriate permission

specific_expectations.text: gather, evaluate, and use information, considering various perspectives, to construct knowledge and demonstrate learning
specific_expectations.text_html: gather, evaluate, and use information, considering various perspectives, to construct knowledge and demonstrate learning

specific_expectations.text: demonstrate an understanding of the forms, conventions, and techniques of digital and media texts, and apply this understanding when analyzing texts
specific_expectations.text_html: demonstrate an understanding of the forms, conventions, and techniques of digital and media texts, and apply this understanding when analyzing texts

specific_expectations.text: demonstrate an understanding of the interrelationships between the form, message, and context of a text, the audience, and the creator
specific_expectations.text_html: demonstrate an understanding of the interrelationships between the form, message, and context of a text, the audience, and the creator

specific_expectations.text: use digital and media tools to support stages of the design process and to develop creative solutions to authentic, real-world problems
specific_expectations.text_html: use digital and media tools to support stages of the design process and to develop creative solutions to authentic, real-world problems

specific_expectations.text: communicate and collaborate with various communities in a safe, respectful, responsible, and inclusive manner when using online platforms and environments, including digital and media tools, and demonstrate cultural awareness with members of the community
specific_expectations.text_html: communicate and collaborate with various communities in a safe, respectful, responsible, and inclusive manner when using online platforms and environments, including digital and media tools, and demonstrate cultural awareness with members of the community

overall_expectations.title: Applications, Connections, and Contributions
overall_expectations.describer: Throughout Grade 1, in connection with the learning in strands B to D, students will:
overall_expectations.text: apply language and literacy skills in cross-curricular and integrated learning, and demonstrate an understanding of, and make connections to, diverse voices, experiences, perspectives, histories, and contributions, including those of First Nations, Métis, and Inuit individuals, communities, groups, and nations
overall_expectations.text_html: apply language and literacy skills in cross-curricular and integrated learning, and demonstrate an understanding of, and make connections to, diverse voices, experiences, perspectives, histories, and contributions, including those of First Nations, Métis, and Inuit individuals, communities, groups, and nations

specific_expectations.text: apply the knowledge and skills developed in this grade to support learning in various subject areas and identify some ways this learning can be used in everyday life
specific_expectations.text_html: apply the knowledge and skills developed in this grade to support learning in various subject areas and identify some ways this learning can be used in everyday life

specific_expectations.text: demonstrate an understanding of the contributions, lived experiences, and perspectives of a diversity of individuals and communities, including those in Canada, by exploring the concepts of identity, self, and sense of belonging in culturally responsive and relevant texts
specific_expectations.text_html: demonstrate an understanding of the contributions, lived experiences, and perspectives of a diversity of individuals and communities, including those in Canada, by exploring the concepts of identity, self, and sense of belonging in culturally responsive and relevant texts

specific_expectations.text: identify themes explored in First Nations, Métis, and Inuit cultures to demonstrate an understanding of the varied identities, perspectives, relationships, legacies, truths, and ways of knowing, being, and doing
specific_expectations.text_html: identify themes explored in First Nations, Métis, and Inuit cultures to demonstrate an understanding of the varied identities, perspectives, relationships, legacies, truths, and ways of knowing, being, and doing

strands.title: Foundations of Language
strands.describer: By the end of Grade 1, students will:

overall_expectations.title: Oral and Non-Verbal Communication
overall_expectations.describer: By the end of Grade 1, students will:
overall_expectations.text: apply listening, speaking, and non-verbal communication skills and strategies to understand and communicate meaning in formal and informal contexts and for various purposes and audiences
overall_expectations.text_html: apply listening, speaking, and non-verbal communication skills and strategies to understand and communicate meaning in formal and informal contexts and for various purposes and audiences

specific_expectations.text: use effective listening skills, including listening attentively and asking relevant questions, in formal and informal contexts, including conversations and classroom activities
specific_expectations.text_html: use effective listening skills, including listening attentively and asking relevant questions, in formal and informal contexts, including conversations and classroom activities

specific_expectations.text: identify and use listening strategies before, during, and after listening to comprehend information communicated orally and non-verbally
specific_expectations.text_html: identify and use listening strategies before, during, and after listening to comprehend information communicated orally and non-verbally

specific_expectations.text: identify the purpose and audience for speaking in formal and informal contexts, and use appropriate speaking strategies, including taking turns, understanding when to speak, and knowing how much to say, to communicate clearly and coherently
specific_expectations.text_html: identify the purpose and audience for speaking in formal and informal contexts, and use appropriate speaking strategies, including taking turns, understanding when to speak, and knowing how much to say, to communicate clearly and coherently

specific_expectations.text: identify and use oral and non-verbal communication strategies, including expression, gestures, and body language, to interpret or contribute to the meaning of messages
specific_expectations.text_html: identify and use oral and non-verbal communication strategies, including expression, gestures, and body language, to interpret or contribute to the meaning of messages

specific_expectations.text: use appropriate word choice, including new vocabulary, grammar, and cohesive phrases and sentences when speaking and communicating ideas
specific_expectations.text_html: use appropriate word choice, including new vocabulary, grammar, and cohesive phrases and sentences when speaking and communicating ideas

overall_expectations.title: Language Foundations for Reading and Writing
overall_expectations.describer: By the end of Grade 1, students will:
overall_expectations.text: demonstrate an understanding of foundational language knowledge and skills, and apply this understanding when reading and writing
overall_expectations.text_html: demonstrate an understanding of foundational language knowledge and skills, and apply this understanding when reading and writing

specific_expectations.text: use understanding of the sound structure of spoken words to orally isolate, blend, and segment phonemes, from simple structures with two phonemes to structures with more phonemes
specific_expectations.text_html: use understanding of the sound structure of spoken words to orally isolate, blend, and segment phonemes, from simple structures with two phonemes to structures with more phonemes

specific_expectations.text: name and form the upper- and lowercase letters both in and out of order and demonstrate knowledge of alphabetic order, with automaticity
specific_expectations.text_html: name and form the upper- and lowercase letters both in and out of order and demonstrate knowledge of alphabetic order, with automaticity

specific_expectations.text: identify, read, and spell most common grapheme-phoneme correspondences of consonants and vowels, with automaticity
specific_expectations.text_html: identify, read, and spell most common grapheme-phoneme correspondences of consonants and vowels, with automaticity

specific_expectations.text: use phonics knowledge and phonemic blending to read words, and phonemic segmentation to spell phonetically regular words, in isolation and various text contexts
specific_expectations.text_html: use phonics knowledge and phonemic blending to read words, and phonemic segmentation to spell phonetically regular words, in isolation and various text contexts

specific_expectations.text: use developing orthographic knowledge, including position-based tendencies, to make a spelling choice or accurately pronounce a word when reading
specific_expectations.text_html: use developing orthographic knowledge, including position-based tendencies, to make a spelling choice or accurately pronounce a word when reading

specific_expectations.text: use developing knowledge of the meanings of words and common morphemes (i.e., bases, prefixes, and suffixes) to read and spell words
specific_expectations.text_html: use developing knowledge of the meanings of words and common morphemes (i.e., bases, prefixes, and suffixes) to read and spell words

specific_expectations.text: demonstrate an understanding of commonly used words, acquire and use explicitly taught vocabulary in various contexts, including other subject areas, and use their developing morphological knowledge to analyze and understand new words in context
specific_expectations.text_html: demonstrate an understanding of commonly used words, acquire and use explicitly taught vocabulary in various contexts, including other subject areas, and use their developing morphological knowledge to analyze and understand new words in context

specific_expectations.text: read simple words, short sentences, and paragraphs in a variety of texts fluently, with accuracy and appropriate pacing to support comprehension, and read aloud with expression
specific_expectations.text_html: read simple words, short sentences, and paragraphs in a variety of texts fluently, with accuracy and appropriate pacing to support comprehension, and read aloud with expression

overall_expectations.title: Language Conventions for Reading and Writing
overall_expectations.describer: By the end of Grade 1, students will:
overall_expectations.text: demonstrate an understanding of sentence structure, grammar, cohesive ties, and capitalization and punctuation, and apply this knowledge when reading and writing sentences, paragraphs, and a variety of texts
overall_expectations.text_html: demonstrate an understanding of sentence structure, grammar, cohesive ties, and capitalization and punctuation, and apply this knowledge when reading and writing sentences, paragraphs, and a variety of texts

specific_expectations.text: identify and construct simple and compound sentences, including declarative, imperative, interrogative, and exclamatory sentences
specific_expectations.text_html: identify and construct simple and compound sentences, including declarative, imperative, interrogative, and exclamatory sentences

specific_expectations.text: demonstrate an understanding of the functions of parts of speech in sentences, including common singular and plural nouns, using the pronoun “I”, the past, present, and future verb tenses, common adjectives and adverbs, and common conjunctions, and use this knowledge to support comprehension and communicate meaning clearly
specific_expectations.text_html: demonstrate an understanding of the functions of parts of speech in sentences, including common singular and plural nouns, using the pronoun “I”, the past, present, and future verb tenses, common adjectives and adverbs, and common conjunctions, and use this knowledge to support comprehension and communicate meaning clearly

specific_expectations.text: use their understanding of the meaning and function of capitalization and punctuation to communicate meaning clearly, including the use of a capital letter at the beginning of a sentence and the appropriate punctuation mark at the end
specific_expectations.text_html: use their understanding of the meaning and function of capitalization and punctuation to communicate meaning clearly, including the use of a capital letter at the beginning of a sentence and the appropriate punctuation mark at the end

strands.title: Comprehension: Understanding and Responding to Texts
strands.describer: By the end of Grade 1, students will:

overall_expectations.title: Knowledge about Texts
overall_expectations.describer: By the end of Grade 1, students will:
overall_expectations.text: apply foundational knowledge and skills to understand a variety of texts, including digital and media texts, by creators with diverse identities, perspectives, and experience, and demonstrate an understanding of the patterns, features, and elements of style associated with various text forms and genres
overall_expectations.text_html: apply foundational knowledge and skills to understand a variety of texts, including digital and media texts, by creators with diverse identities, perspectives, and experience, and demonstrate an understanding of the patterns, features, and elements of style associated with various text forms and genres

specific_expectations.text: read and comprehend short, simple texts, using knowledge of words, grammar, cohesive ties, sentence structures, and background knowledge
specific_expectations.text_html: read and comprehend short, simple texts, using knowledge of words, grammar, cohesive ties, sentence structures, and background knowledge

specific_expectations.text: identify simple literary and informational text forms and their associated genres
specific_expectations.text_html: identify simple literary and informational text forms and their associated genres

specific_expectations.text: identify some text patterns, such as sequencing and chronological order, and text features, including illustrations, symbols, and titles, associated with various text forms, and explain how they help readers, listeners, and viewers understand the meaning
specific_expectations.text_html: identify some text patterns, such as sequencing and chronological order, and text features, including illustrations, symbols, and titles, associated with various text forms, and explain how they help readers, listeners, and viewers understand the meaning

specific_expectations.text: demonstrate an understanding of the relationship between simple illustrations, images, and graphics and the text
specific_expectations.text_html: demonstrate an understanding of the relationship between simple illustrations, images, and graphics and the text

specific_expectations.text: identify some simple elements of style in texts, including voice, word choice, word patterns, and sentence structure, and describe how they help communicate meaning
specific_expectations.text_html: identify some simple elements of style in texts, including voice, word choice, word patterns, and sentence structure, and describe how they help communicate meaning

specific_expectations.text: identify the narrator’s point of view in a variety of texts, and suggest an alternative point of view to tell the story
specific_expectations.text_html: identify the narrator’s point of view in a variety of texts, and suggest an alternative point of view to tell the story

specific_expectations.text: read, listen to, and view various forms of texts by diverse First Nations, Métis, and Inuit creators to demonstrate understanding of various aspects of First Nations, Métis, and Inuit histories, cultures, relationships, communities, groups, nations, and lived experiences
specific_expectations.text_html: read, listen to, and view various forms of texts by diverse First Nations, Métis, and Inuit creators to demonstrate understanding of various aspects of First Nations, Métis, and Inuit histories, cultures, relationships, communities, groups, nations, and lived experiences

overall_expectations.title: Comprehension Strategies
overall_expectations.describer: By the end of Grade 1, students will:
overall_expectations.text: apply comprehension strategies before, during, and after reading, listening to, and viewing a variety of texts, including digital and media texts, by creators with diverse identities, perspectives, and experience, in order to understand and clarify the meaning of texts
overall_expectations.text_html: apply comprehension strategies before, during, and after reading, listening to, and viewing a variety of texts, including digital and media texts, by creators with diverse identities, perspectives, and experience, in order to understand and clarify the meaning of texts

specific_expectations.text: activate prior knowledge, including knowledge gained from personal and text experiences, that they can use to understand the topics of new texts
specific_expectations.text_html: activate prior knowledge, including knowledge gained from personal and text experiences, that they can use to understand the topics of new texts

specific_expectations.text: identify purposes for engaging with texts, including enjoyment or finding information
specific_expectations.text_html: identify purposes for engaging with texts, including enjoyment or finding information

specific_expectations.text: make predictions using background knowledge, text features, and evidence from the text
specific_expectations.text_html: make predictions using background knowledge, text features, and evidence from the text

specific_expectations.text: use strategies such as rereading, visualizing, and asking questions, to monitor their understanding of simple texts
specific_expectations.text_html: use strategies such as rereading, visualizing, and asking questions, to monitor their understanding of simple texts

specific_expectations.text: identify connections between ideas expressed in simple texts and their knowledges and lived experiences, the ideas in other familiar texts, and the world around them
specific_expectations.text_html: identify connections between ideas expressed in simple texts and their knowledges and lived experiences, the ideas in other familiar texts, and the world around them

specific_expectations.text: identify important information in a simple text, including the main idea
specific_expectations.text_html: identify important information in a simple text, including the main idea

specific_expectations.text: identify strategies, such as activating prior knowledge and visualizing, that have helped them comprehend texts
specific_expectations.text_html: identify strategies, such as activating prior knowledge and visualizing, that have helped them comprehend texts

overall_expectations.title: Critical Thinking in Literacy
overall_expectations.describer: By the end of Grade 1, students will:
overall_expectations.text: apply critical thinking skills to deepen understanding of texts, and analyze how various perspectives and topics are communicated and addressed in a variety of texts, including digital, media, and cultural texts
overall_expectations.text_html: apply critical thinking skills to deepen understanding of texts, and analyze how various perspectives and topics are communicated and addressed in a variety of texts, including digital, media, and cultural texts

specific_expectations.text: identify simple literary devices, including rhyme, alliteration, and onomatopoeia, and describe how they help communicate meaning
specific_expectations.text_html: identify simple literary devices, including rhyme, alliteration, and onomatopoeia, and describe how they help communicate meaning

specific_expectations.text: make simple inferences, using stated and implied information and ideas, to understand simple texts
specific_expectations.text_html: make simple inferences, using stated and implied information and ideas, to understand simple texts

specific_expectations.text: analyze simple texts, including literary and informational texts, by identifying and sequencing important information and events
specific_expectations.text_html: analyze simple texts, including literary and informational texts, by identifying and sequencing important information and events

specific_expectations.text: identify some cultural elements represented in various texts, including symbols and values, and explain how these elements contribute to the meaning
specific_expectations.text_html: identify some cultural elements represented in various texts, including symbols and values, and explain how these elements contribute to the meaning

specific_expectations.text: identify explicit and implicit perspectives communicated in a text, and describe how these perspectives could influence an audience
specific_expectations.text_html: identify explicit and implicit perspectives communicated in a text, and describe how these perspectives could influence an audience

specific_expectations.text: express personal thoughts and feelings about ideas presented in texts, such as ideas about diversity, inclusion, and accessibility
specific_expectations.text_html: express personal thoughts and feelings about ideas presented in texts, such as ideas about diversity, inclusion, and accessibility

specific_expectations.text: identify some ways in which texts created by First Nations, Métis, and Inuit individuals, communities, groups, or nations communicate about historical periods, cultural experiences, and events, and how they relate to current lived experiences
specific_expectations.text_html: identify some ways in which texts created by First Nations, Métis, and Inuit individuals, communities, groups, or nations communicate about historical periods, cultural experiences, and events, and how they relate to current lived experiences

specific_expectations.text: identify thinking skills that helped them understand simple texts
specific_expectations.text_html: identify thinking skills that helped them understand simple texts

strands.title: Composition: Expressing Ideas and Creating Texts
strands.describer: By the end of Grade 1, students will:

overall_expectations.title: Developing Ideas and Organizing Content
overall_expectations.describer: By the end of Grade 1, students will:
overall_expectations.text: plan, develop ideas, gather information, and organize content for creating texts of various forms, including digital and media texts, on a variety of topics
overall_expectations.text_html: plan, develop ideas, gather information, and organize content for creating texts of various forms, including digital and media texts, on a variety of topics

specific_expectations.text: identify the topic, purpose, and audience for various simple texts they plan to create
specific_expectations.text_html: identify the topic, purpose, and audience for various simple texts they plan to create

specific_expectations.text: generate ideas about given and chosen topics, using simple strategies and drawing on various resources, including their own lived experiences, and learning from other subject areas
specific_expectations.text_html: generate ideas about given and chosen topics, using simple strategies and drawing on various resources, including their own lived experiences, and learning from other subject areas

specific_expectations.text: gather information and content relevant to a topic, using a single source
specific_expectations.text_html: gather information and content relevant to a topic, using a single source

specific_expectations.text: sort and sequence ideas and information, taking into account the text form and genre to be used
specific_expectations.text_html: sort and sequence ideas and information, taking into account the text form and genre to be used

specific_expectations.text: identify the strategies that helped them to develop ideas for texts
specific_expectations.text_html: identify the strategies that helped them to develop ideas for texts

overall_expectations.title: Creating Texts
overall_expectations.describer: By the end of Grade 1, students will:
overall_expectations.text: apply knowledge and understanding of various text forms and genres to create, revise, edit, and proofread their own texts, using a variety of media, tools, and/or strategies, and reflect critically on created texts
overall_expectations.text_html: apply knowledge and understanding of various text forms and genres to create, revise, edit, and proofread their own texts, using a variety of media, tools, and/or strategies, and reflect critically on created texts

specific_expectations.text: draft short, simple texts of various forms and genres, including personal narratives, persuasive texts, and procedural texts, using a variety of media, tools, and strategies
specific_expectations.text_html: draft short, simple texts of various forms and genres, including personal narratives, persuasive texts, and procedural texts, using a variety of media, tools, and strategies

specific_expectations.text: print letters and words with appropriate formation patterns, size, placement, and spacing
specific_expectations.text_html: print letters and words with appropriate formation patterns, size, placement, and spacing

specific_expectations.text: demonstrate a personal voice in their texts, with a focus on using words that express their thoughts, feelings, and opinions about the topic
specific_expectations.text_html: demonstrate a personal voice in their texts, with a focus on using words that express their thoughts, feelings, and opinions about the topic

specific_expectations.text: identify the point of view, including first person, used in their texts
specific_expectations.text_html: identify the point of view, including first person, used in their texts

specific_expectations.text: make simple edits to draft texts, such as changes to capitalization, punctuation, and spelling
specific_expectations.text_html: make simple edits to draft texts, such as changes to capitalization, punctuation, and spelling

overall_expectations.title: Publishing, Presenting, and Reflecting
overall_expectations.describer: By the end of Grade 1, students will:
overall_expectations.text: select suitable and effective media, techniques, and tools to publish and present final texts, and critically analyze how well the texts address various topics
overall_expectations.text_html: select suitable and effective media, techniques, and tools to publish and present final texts, and critically analyze how well the texts address various topics

specific_expectations.text: produce final texts, using simple techniques, to achieve the intended effect
specific_expectations.text_html: produce final texts, using simple techniques, to achieve the intended effect

specific_expectations.text: present the texts they have created using appropriate strategies, including by reading aloud with expression
specific_expectations.text_html: present the texts they have created using appropriate strategies, including by reading aloud with expression

specific_expectations.text: identify a strategy they found helpful when presenting texts
specific_expectations.text_html: identify a strategy they found helpful when presenting texts
